competences.description: Summons 5 magic spheres, which each can inflict damage equal to 150% of your Attack Power. If you get attacked from an enemy while you still have magic spheres, uses 1 magic sphere to counterattack, recovers your HP by the counterattack damage dealt, and increases your Attack Bar by 50%. When you attack on your turn, all remaining spheres will attack the enemy target together.
